input: Research accessible bathroom modifications for aging parents

gold.taskTitle: Research Accessible Bathroom Modifications for Aging Parents
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify the most suitable accessible bathroom modification options for aging parents based on their specific needs, home setup, and budget.

questions.title: Which parent or parents does this research cover?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is for one or both parents, and their ages.

questions.title: What specific mobility or health challenges do they have?
questions.description: Understand the physical limitations driving the need for modifications, such as balance issues, wheelchair use, or arthritis.

questions.title: Do they own their home or rent their living space?
questions.description: Determine whether structural modifications are permitted or if only removable solutions are viable.

questions.title: What is the approximate budget available for these modifications?
questions.description: Establish a financial range to filter recommendations between low-cost aids and full remodels.

questions.title: Is this for an immediate safety concern or future planning?
questions.description: Determine the urgency of the modifications to prioritize quick fixes versus long-term remodeling plans.

questions.title: Has a doctor or occupational therapist already made recommendations?
questions.description: Find out if there is existing professional guidance that should shape the research direction.

questions.title: Should the research include funding sources or financial assistance programs?
questions.description: Clarify whether to look into grants, insurance coverage, or government programs that offset modification costs.
